🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Tiere (Animals)

das Schaf = sheep
das Schwein = pig
die Maus = mouse
der Hase = rabbit
die Ente = duck
der Löwe = lion

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
